Three lazy-loaded modules: AdminModule, ProctorModule, CandidateModule. Communicates via HTTP (REST) and WebSocket (SignalR). JWT stored in memory (not localStorage).
REST controllers for all CRUD operations. SignalR ExamHub for real-time events. IHostedService for server-side exam timer broadcasting. Role-based authorization middleware.
WebSocket hub managing exam groups. Broadcasts timer ticks, tab-switch flags, candidate status, and proctor commands. Falls back to SSE/long-polling if WebSocket unavailable.
Services: ExamTimerService, GradingService, RandomisationService, CertificateService, TokenService. Separated from controllers for testability.
Code-first ORM with migrations. Repository pattern for data access abstraction. Async LINQ queries throughout.
Relational store for all application data. Indexes on ExamId, CandidateId, AttemptId for query performance. Soft deletes on Users and Exams.
